capabilities: Browse vault files and folders with vim-style keybindings
Preview Markdown, images, audio, video, PDFs, text files, and Bases
Create, rename, copy, move, and delete files and folders from the keyboard
Open the current folder in the system file manager or terminal
problem: Obsidian's file explorer relies on mouse interaction, which disrupts users who want to navigate and manage their vault entirely from the keyboard.
summary: Keyboard-driven file browser that navigates, previews, and manages vault files and folders using vim-style keybindings.
